title: Workshop: build an article page
summary: Pin a header, a sidebar, a floating button and a banner, and layer a tag and caption over a photo.
intro: an article page with a sticky header and contents list, a photo with a tag and caption laid over it, a floating button and a cookie banner. The HTML is already written (see the html tab). Each step uses one positioning value, and the preview scrolls so you can see them work.
